notes: Türkiye, Turkish: the İçişleri Bakanlığı Sivil Savunma İdaresi teaches the three alarm tones — SARI İKAZ (continuous, ~620-790 Hz), KIRMIZI İKAZ (undulating) and SERPİNTİ İKAZI (intermittent) — with the transmitter room, the rooftop siren horn, the shelter drill and the all-clear.
